newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gaumont shares rally on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Gaumont shares rally on H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Gaumont were up 24 francs, or nearly seven percent, at 379 at 1410 GMT after the film theatre company reported a big rise in first-half profit.

Brokers said the market was pleased with Gaumont's results, showing a rise in first-half net attributable profit to 33.7 million francs from 30.4 million. But they noted volume was a modest 4,218 shares.
